product_name: OnePlus Nord CE6 Lite | 6GB+128GB | Hyper Black | Segment's Fastest Dimensity 7400 Apex Processor | 7000mAh Battery | Segment's Highest 144Hz Refresh Rate | 50MP Main Camera, 4K Video Recording
description: Segment's fastest phone with 1.03Mn+ AnTuTu score: MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Apex Processor with enhanced performance, an advanced power-efficient chip, delivering smoother multitasking, faster app launches, and a lag-free everyday experience. Massive 7000mAh Battery: More Power, Less Charging. Power that lasts up to 2 days with a massive 7000mAh battery, backed by 45W SUPERVOOC fast charging for quick top-ups. Enjoy up to 81.7 hours of music playback, 26.2 hours of YouTube streaming, and 11.7 hours of video calls on a full charge. Even a quick 10-minute charge gives you up to 7.5 hours of calls, 2.2 hours of YouTube, and 1.4 hours of gaming. Segment's highest FPS for gaming: Experience the segment’s highest FPS for gaming with up to 144 FPS support for ultra-smooth, responsive gameplay and up to 90 FPS for top-rated shooters. Stay ahead with faster reactions and seamless performance. Plus, a category-leading 5,300 mm² VC cooling system and 5G++ network to keep your intense gaming cool and smooth, ensuring stable performance so you can play longer and win more. Segment's highest 144Hz refresh rate display: Enjoy a super-smooth 144Hz display that delivers fast, fluid visuals in every swipe. Experience clear viewing even in bright sunlight with up to 1000 nits peak brightness for an immersive experience. With Aqua Touch for precise control, even with wet or oil fingers, everything feels fast, clear, and effortless. 4K video recording. Triple Camera. Made for Every Moment: 50MP main camera, 8MP front camera, and 2MP depth-assist camera, built to capture every moment with clarity. Capture every moment in 4K at 30 FPS with sharper detail and smoother motion. Bring memories to life with 4K Motion Photos, rich, vivid, and ready to replay. Smoothness for 5 Years, Built for You: Real-world toughness meets military-grade durability, built to stay fast and smooth for 5 years.
